merge_resolution_verdict: CLEAN: deep-copied captured rows combined with supported owner cleanup and profile crash child; both summarize+working_set imported and used; CI refresh only discovery digest, independently recomputed, every other policy value matches both parents.
persistent_vlog_verdict: Observed below-cap lane0 growth fits intentional current-segment retention. No new unbounded physical retaining-owner bug established. Total database or live-plus-budget boundedness remains unproven.

finite_policy.active_selection: newest per ordinary value lane plus every current-writable file; protected mode may retain two recent IDs per protected lane; pending append IDs independently retained
finite_policy.inactive_progress: exhaustive rewrite selects positive-live stale inactive files with1B threshold; fully dead goes to GC; recovery roots/pending/reader/identity pins lawfully defer deletion
finite_policy.multiple_lanes: chooseRewriteLane prefers unused nonzero value lane, excluding reserved leaf lane255; a single4GiB cap is not the whole kept-file budget

required_next_discriminator: When source-bound workload naturally crosses ordinary writer rotation, census per-ID lane/seq/bytes/writable/newest, live/stale estimates, exact current/fallback/pending descriptor membership and file/identity pins; show prior lane0 file becomes eligible and is physically unlinked after rewrite, final root convergence and reader release. Keep held-view and corrupted-newest-meta reopen oracles. Existing512B rotation unit test proves writer seam, not4096/1024 full maintenance post-rotation progress. No experiment run in this inquiry.
residual_memory_observation: rewriteWriter.createdIDs and createdSegments append per created file; publication acknowledgement advances an index without trimming histories. These are metadata, not retained file authority, so they do not explain observed physical vlog growth. Do not infer duration-independent retained heap bounds across many rotations from the segment cap. Broader lifetime ownership remains with existing owners.
acceptance: No numerical capacity threshold introduced, no sustained-capacity waiver or product readiness claim.

sealed_segment_addendum.head: 4b78a03d7ffea4e34a8d78f78c53c89bb9b8e064
sealed_segment_addendum.verdict: No source evidence that ordinary ResourceValueLog IDs are cloned forever after they become unreachable; integrated rotation and actual retirement remain unmeasured.
sealed_segment_addendum.publication: durable_root_runtime.go:873 excludes ResourceValueLog from inherited closure; :643 captures current references by exact projection or scan; under outer-leaf profile :286 refuses logical-only projection. Rebuilt exact scan :1344-1356 excludes ResourceValueLog and recaptures references. Unchanged-root projection :1174-1189 deliberately retains its exact logical closure; it does not add historical IDs.
sealed_segment_addendum.rewrite: vlog_rewrite.go:3027-3036 subtracts old pointer references and adds new pointer references on successful matched swaps. :2164 delegates retirement to fresh recoverable-root GC. Cold live pointers require evacuation; they are not eligible for deletion merely because their segment is sealed.
sealed_segment_addendum.fallback: command_wal_publish.go:261 waits for visible publication and republishes same root/LSN when slots differ, verifying convergence. durable_root_runtime.go:1908-1914 replaces destination slot resources and releases previousResources only after durable publication.
sealed_segment_addendum.multiplicity: vlog_gc.go:669 keeps highest sequence per lane plus current writable IDs. chooseRewriteLane at vlog_rewrite.go:5821 uses successive unused non-leaf lanes before lane 0 fallback. Thus sealed lane-0 files may progress after rotation, but retained latest outputs across lanes preclude treating one segment target as total retention budget.
sealed_segment_addendum.next_discriminator: Naturally cross replay-writer rotation; inspect former lane-0 file live references, successful rewrite swaps, selected current and fallback closure membership, file/identity pins and actual unlink after existing final convergence plus GC. If live references are zero but CURRENT ResourceValueLog descriptor persists after exact capture, investigate closure bug with external5037 owner; if closure clears but deletion stalls, discriminate newest-lane retention versus owned pins. No such failure established by below-cap five-epoch data.
